Naga-supported-synthetic.synapse4 is a synthetic regression fixture in the actual Synapse 4 JSON/base64 envelope format. It is derived from the bundled parser schema and tests, not captured from hardware or claimed as an official user export. It contains one exact-model profile, one Ctrl+C assignment, and an overlapping A/B macro with a 25 ms delay. The cross-layer test passes the file through the production preview/conversion entry point before saving and executing with memory HID.
